channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: In California, a customer confronts her food delivery driver after an issue with her order. In Flagler Beach, Florida, a belligerent bar patron squanders multiple opportunities to avoid arrest. A shoplifting accusation at a supermarket in London, England, spirals into a violent clash. And on a flight in California, passengers face an emergency evacuation when the cabin begins filling with smoke.
